workflow.description: Global shopper traffic enters through Front Door, which routes it through the nearest regional Web Application Firewall.
WAF inspects and forwards TLS-terminated checkout requests to the regional App Service.
App Service validates the customer's token with Microsoft Entra ID and retrieves payment credentials from Key Vault.
App Service queries the local readable secondary of SQL Database for product catalog, pricing, and inventory.
Customer submits an order; App Service writes the customer profile to Cosmos DB in the assigned home region and enqueues the order to Service Bus.
Azure Functions dequeues the order from Service Bus and begins payment and fulfillment processing asynchronously.
Functions persist the order record in Cosmos DB using the customer's home-region partition, enforcing data residency while allowing global write acceptance.
Functions update catalog inventory in SQL Database; changes replicate to the secondary region to keep the catalog globally available.
App Service emits checkout telemetry and audit events to Azure Monitor, which forwards them to Log Analytics.
Microsoft Sentinel ingests Log Analytics audit logs for PCI compliance monitoring, threat detection, and centralized audit telemetry.
